title: FIELD SAMPLING OF FISH AND WILDLIFE
description: Introduction to sampling populations and communities of vertebrate animals emphasizing sampling design, collection and management of data, and communication of results.
registration_restrictions:
Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a major in Fish, Wildlife & Conserv Scien (018) or Fisheries & Wildlife Sciences (733).
recommendations: WR 121Z and familiarity with personal computers
meeting_html: R 12pm-3:50pm in WITH 074 - Withycombe Hall 074 (PC) (9/23 to 12/4)
